description: Implementation of the CalculatorDisplay class providing concrete methods for the ICalcDisplay interface, managing display updates and callbacks in a calculator application.

classes.name: CalculatorDisplay
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the ICalcDisplay interface, handling display updates and callback management for the calculator.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Sets the weak reference callback for display updates.

methods.name: SetHistoryCallback
methods.description: Sets the weak reference callback for history updates.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Updates the primary display with a string value and error state.

methods.name: SetParenthesisNumber
methods.description: Sets the count of open parentheses.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Handles event when no right parenthesis is added.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state of the display.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbers
methods.description: Updates the list of memorized numbers.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles event when a new history item is added.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles event when maximum digit limit is reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Handles event when a binary operator is received.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Handles event when a memory item is changed.
